results: Platform health is reachable
Workspace requires a verified Firebase identity
A new workspace starts empty with NVIDIA selected
Mutations reject an unrelated web origin
Purpose-specific data sources persist and validate
Market and sector filters return real listing metadata without invented quotes
Missing market credentials produce an explicit data gap
A quantitative scan requires an explicitly entitled source
FIFO holdings, fees and realized gains reconcile without a fabricated valuation
Overselling and deleting a required acquisition are rejected
Editing an acquisition recalculates the complete ledger
Currencies remain separate until an actual FX valuation exists
Another account cannot read or modify private transactions
Watchlists persist with account isolation
Provider credentials are masked in settings responses
Workspace export includes saved records and excludes raw credentials
Deleting a provider key removes authenticated model access
Market data requires explicit entitlement confirmation and supports key deletion
Planning rejects fractional cents and incomplete market splits
Plan scheduling is durable and idempotent
Agent job results are private to their owner
An actual two-year plan reserves principal and conserves the exact budget
A full immediate-needs reserve handles zero investable budget without fictional positions
Completed plans survive a fresh workspace load
Removing a finished plan also retires its historical memory
Workspace reset removes records, plans and account credentials
limitations: Direct NVIDIA, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and entitled stock-data inference require account keys; this suite never substitutes financial data.
Google popup sign-in and account-link collision are covered separately by browser and contract checks.
